<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula: DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2. For C8H14NO, C=8, H=14, N=1, X=0. DBE = (2*8 + 2 + 1 - 14)/2 = (16+2+1-14)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the most plausible integer value for this neutral molecule is 2 (indicating one ring and one double bond).</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
